generic.Defined scope/population: Full employee population in the current pay period subject to pre-processing edits in ADP Payroll
generic.In-scope period: The active pay period being edited before the pay run calculates
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Cost center, pay rate, and hours fields populated and valid for every employee row
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exception report row count matches the pay period's total active headcount
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Exception report and clearance notes retained with run timestamp and version
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each negative-pay, missing-cost-center, or overtime exception logged with disposition
generic.Test population: Sample of flagged exceptions plus a random sample of cleared rows from the current run
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero open exceptions remain after the final exception report re-run
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved exceptions route to the timekeeping approver before the run proceeds
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Exception report shows zero open anomalies before the pay run calculates
generic.Evidence location: ADP Payroll exception report archive for the pay period

steps.title: Run the pre-processing exception report in ADP Payroll
sop: Open the current pay period in ADP Payroll and launch the pre-processing exception report.
Select all employee categories so no population is excluded from the scan.
Done when the exception report generates with a record count matching total headcount.
verify: Compare the report's row count to the pay period's active headcount.
Pass when the two counts match with no employees excluded.

steps.title: Clear each negative-pay exception flagged on the report
sop: Open each negative-pay exception and trace it to the source timecard or adjustment entry.
Correct the entry or obtain written justification if the negative amount is valid.
Done when every negative-pay flag is cleared or documented as valid.
verify: Re-pull the exception report and check for remaining negative-pay flags.
Pass when zero negative-pay exceptions remain unresolved.

steps.title: Confirm every employee row carries a valid cost center code
sop: Filter the exception report for missing or invalid cost-center codes.
Look up the correct cost center in Workday HCM and update the ADP Payroll record.
Done when every employee row shows a valid, active cost-center code.
verify: Re-run the missing-cost-center filter against the corrected file.
Pass when no employee row returns a blank or invalid cost center.

steps.title: Route unreasonable-overtime exceptions to the timekeeping approver
sop: Identify hours exceeding the configured overtime threshold on the exception report.
Send the flagged records to the timekeeping approver for confirmation or correction.
Done when the approver returns a confirmed or corrected hours figure for each flag.
verify: Check the exception report for the approver's response on each flagged record.
Pass when every overtime flag carries a documented approver decision.

steps.title: Re-run the exception report to confirm zero open anomalies
sop: Re-generate the pre-processing exception report in ADP Payroll after corrections.
Scan the refreshed report for any remaining negative-pay, cost-center, or overtime flags.
Done when the refreshed report returns zero open exceptions.
verify: Review the refreshed exception report line by line for open flags.
Pass when zero open anomalies remain on the final report.

steps.title: Archive the exception report and clearance notes
sop: Export the final exception report with a run timestamp and version label.
Attach clearance notes for each exception to the archived file.
Done when the report and notes are saved to the pay-period evidence folder.
verify: Open the archived folder and confirm the report and notes are present.
Pass when the timestamped file with clearance notes is retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: All employees paid in the current cycle subject to federal, state, FICA, and FUTA withholding
generic.In-scope period: The current pay period's calculated run before commit
generic.Required fields populated and valid: W-4 elections, tax jurisdiction, and wage base fields populated and valid for every employee
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total statutory deductions on the register reconcile to the prior period within tolerance
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Withholding tax table version and pay register retained with run date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each withholding or FICA/FUTA variance logged with root cause and correction
generic.Test population: Sample of employees across pay bands plus any flagged withholding variance
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Federal/state withholding, FICA, and FUTA calculated at current statutory rates for every employee
generic.Exception handling path: Withholding discrepancies route back to Payroll Specialist for tax-table correction before commit
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Register shows statutory deductions at current rates with no unexplained variance
generic.Evidence location: ADP Payroll tax register and tax-table version log for the pay period

steps.title: Confirm the current withholding tax tables are loaded in ADP Payroll
sop: Open the ADP Payroll tax table administration screen for the current tax year.
Compare the loaded federal and state table version against the published effective date.
Done when the loaded table version matches the current published tax tables.
verify: Check the table version number against the vendor's published release.
Pass when the loaded version matches the current effective tax tables.

steps.title: Verify employee W-4 elections match calculated withholding
sop: Pull the W-4 election on file for a sample of employees from Workday HCM.
Compare each election to the withholding amount shown on the ADP pay register.
Done when the sampled elections match the register's calculated withholding.
verify: Recalculate withholding manually for two sampled employees.
Pass when the manual recalculation matches the register within a cent.

steps.title: Confirm FICA is calculated at the current statutory rate and wage base
sop: Pull the FICA rate and wage base configured in ADP Payroll for the current year.
Compare the configured rate and wage base to the current IRS-published figures.
Done when the configured FICA settings match the current statutory rate and wage base.
verify: Spot-check FICA withheld for an employee nearing the wage base cap.
Pass when FICA stops accruing once the wage base is reached.

steps.title: Confirm FUTA is calculated on wages up to the statutory wage base
sop: Pull the FUTA wage base configuration from ADP Payroll for the current year.
Confirm FUTA is suspended once an employee's year-to-date wages exceed the base.
Done when FUTA calculation stops correctly at the statutory wage base.
verify: Check FUTA accrual for an employee who crossed the wage base mid-year.
Pass when no FUTA accrues on wages above the statutory base.

steps.title: Reconcile total statutory deductions against the prior pay period
sop: Pull total federal, state, FICA, and FUTA deductions for the current and prior period.
Compare the two totals for reasonableness given headcount and pay changes.
Done when any variance beyond tolerance is explained and documented.
verify: Review the documented variance explanation against the reconciliation.
Pass when every variance beyond tolerance has a recorded root cause.

steps.title: Document tax-table version and register in the evidence file
sop: Export the pay register and tax-table version reference for the period.
Save both files with the pay-period date to the payroll evidence folder.
Done when the register and table version are retrievable together.
verify: Open the evidence folder and confirm both files are present.
Pass when the register and matching tax-table version are both retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: Completed pay-period register and all supporting payroll files for the period
generic.In-scope period: The just-closed pay period being archived
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Pay period end date, legal entity, and retention class populated on the archive package
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Archived file count matches the source pay-period register file count
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archived package tagged with archive date and retention class
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any missing or corrupted archive file logged and re-exported
generic.Test population: The full archived package for the pay period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Archive index shows the new entry with read-only, access-restricted files
generic.Exception handling path: Failed archive exports route back to Payroll Specialist for re-export
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Archive package is tagged, retention-flagged, and access-restricted per policy
generic.Evidence location: OpenText Document Mgmt payroll archive index

steps.title: Export the completed pay-period register from ADP Payroll
sop: Open the committed pay run in ADP Payroll and select the export-to-archive function.
Include all supporting files (register, deductions detail, tax summary) in the export.
Done when the export package is generated for the closed pay period.
verify: Open the export package and confirm all supporting files are present.
Pass when the register and supporting files are all included.

steps.title: Tag the archived package with period, entity, and retention class
sop: Add the pay period end date, legal entity, and retention class to the package metadata.
Confirm the tags match the naming convention used in OpenText Document Mgmt.
Done when all three metadata tags are applied to the package.
verify: Open the package properties and check each metadata field.
Pass when period, entity, and retention class are all populated correctly.

steps.title: Apply the payroll records retention period to the package
sop: Look up the statutory minimum and company policy retention period for payroll records.
Apply the longer of the two retention periods to the archived package.
Done when the retention period field is set on the package.
verify: Check the applied retention period against the retention schedule.
Pass when the applied period meets or exceeds the statutory minimum.

steps.title: Confirm the archive index reflects the new payroll entry
sop: Open the OpenText Document Mgmt archive index for payroll records.
Search for the newly archived pay-period package by period and entity.
Done when the new entry appears correctly indexed.
verify: Search the index by pay-period date and legal entity.
Pass when the new archive entry is found with correct metadata.

steps.title: Verify archived files are read-only and access-restricted
sop: Check the file permissions on the newly archived payroll package.
Confirm access is limited to authorized payroll staff roles only.
Done when the files show read-only status and restricted access.
verify: Attempt to open file properties as a non-payroll test account.
Pass when access is denied and files show read-only status.

steps.title: Sign off the archive as complete and compliant
sop: Review the tagged, retention-flagged, and access-restricted package as a final check.
Record sign-off with reviewer name and date on the archive log.
Done when the payroll archive log shows the sign-off entry.
verify: Open the archive log and confirm the sign-off entry.
Pass when the log shows a dated sign-off for this pay period.

generic.Defined scope/population: All paid employees in the current cycle eligible for a pay stub
generic.In-scope period: The current committed pay run's cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Pay-stub file generated with amounts for every paid employee
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Published stub count matches the committed pay run's paid-employee count
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Publish confirmation log retained with cycle date and stub count
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each failed or missing stub delivery logged with resolution
generic.Test population: Sample of published stubs plus all flagged delivery failures
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Publish confirmation log shows zero failed deliveries
generic.Exception handling path: Failed deliveries route to fallback delivery method for the affected employee
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: All paid employees receive a stub via self-service or fallback delivery
generic.Evidence location: Workday HCM publish confirmation log for the pay cycle

steps.title: Confirm the committed pay run generated a stub for every paid employee
sop: Open the committed pay run's stub-generation output in ADP Payroll.
Compare the generated stub count to the total paid-employee count.
Done when a stub file exists for every paid employee.
verify: Cross-check the stub count against the paid-employee count.
Pass when the two counts match exactly.

steps.title: Publish pay stubs to the Workday employee self-service portal
sop: Load the generated stub file into the Workday HCM self-service publish tool.
Trigger the publish job for the current cycle.
Done when the publish job completes and stubs appear in employee accounts.
verify: Log into a test or sample employee account and view the published stub.
Pass when the stub is visible and accurate in self-service.

steps.title: Spot-check published stubs against the ADP pay register
sop: Select a random sample of published stubs across pay types.
Compare each stub's gross, deductions, and net pay to the ADP register.
Done when the sampled stubs match the register exactly.
verify: Recompute one sampled stub's net pay from gross and deductions.
Pass when the recomputed figure matches the published stub.

steps.title: Confirm employees without self-service access get the fallback delivery
sop: Identify employees without active self-service portal access.
Trigger the fallback delivery method (mail or in-person) for those employees.
Done when every no-access employee has a confirmed alternate delivery.
verify: Check the fallback delivery log against the no-access employee list.
Pass when every no-access employee shows a confirmed delivery.

steps.title: Confirm the publish confirmation log shows zero failed deliveries
sop: Open the publish confirmation log for the current cycle in Workday HCM.
Scan for any failed or error status delivery entries.
Done when the log shows zero failed delivery entries.
verify: Filter the log for failed or error status.
Pass when the filter returns zero results.

steps.title: Retain the publish log as cycle evidence
sop: Export the publish confirmation log with the cycle date.
Save the log to the payroll cycle evidence folder.
Done when the log is retrievable with the cycle date attached.
verify: Open the evidence folder and locate the saved log.
Pass when the log with cycle date is present and readable.

generic.Defined scope/population: The calculated pay run for the current cycle awaiting commit
generic.In-scope period: The pay period whose run is being locked and committed
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Gross-to-net reconciliation and approval reference populated before commit
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Committed amounts match the approved pay register total to the cent
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Commit timestamp and preparer recorded on the pay-run audit log
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any mismatch between committed and approved totals logged and resolved before commit
generic.Test population: The full committed pay run for the cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pay run status shows Committed with locked amounts matching the approved register
generic.Exception handling path: Mismatches route back to the reconciliation step before commit is allowed
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Pay run status changes to Committed only after approval and reconciliation are confirmed
generic.Evidence location: ADP Payroll pay-run audit log for the cycle

steps.title: Confirm gross-to-net reconciliation is completed and approved
sop: Open the reconciled gross-to-net register for the current pay period.
Confirm the reconciliation carries a sign-off from the required approver.
Done when the reconciliation shows a completed, approved status.
verify: Check the reconciliation record for the sign-off entry.
Pass when a completed sign-off is present before proceeding.

steps.title: Lock the pay run in ADP Payroll
sop: Open the calculated pay run and select the lock/commit function.
Confirm the lock action to prevent further input changes.
Done when the system confirms the run is locked.
verify: Attempt to open an input field on the locked run.
Pass when the system blocks any further input change.

steps.title: Confirm the commit timestamp and preparer are recorded
sop: Open the pay-run audit log after the commit action.
Verify the timestamp and preparer name are captured automatically.
Done when both fields appear correctly on the audit log.
verify: Review the audit log entry for timestamp and preparer.
Pass when both fields are present and accurate.

steps.title: Verify committed amounts match the approved register to the cent
sop: Compare the committed run's total to the approved pay register total.
Investigate any difference down to the cent.
Done when the two totals match exactly.
verify: Recompute the difference between committed and approved totals.
Pass when the difference is zero.

steps.title: Confirm the pay run status shows Committed before release
sop: Open the pay run status field after the lock action completes.
Confirm the status reads Committed rather than Calculated or Draft.
Done when the status field shows Committed.
verify: View the pay run status field directly.
Pass when the status reads Committed.

steps.title: Confirm disbursement instructions are not released before commit
sop: Check that no disbursement or funding instruction was issued before the commit.
Confirm the commit precedes any bank funding request timestamp.
Done when disbursement instructions post-date the commit timestamp.
verify: Compare the commit timestamp to the funding-instruction timestamp.
Pass when commit occurs strictly before any disbursement instruction.

generic.Defined scope/population: The committed pay run's total net-pay amount for the cycle
generic.In-scope period: The disbursement date for the current committed pay run
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Funding request amount, bank account, and approval reference populated before release
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Funding request total matches the committed run's net-pay total exactly
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Funding transaction reference number recorded against the pay run
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any funding amount mismatch or insufficient balance logged and resolved before release
generic.Test population: The full funding transaction for the committed pay run
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Bank funding confirmed for the exact committed net-pay amount before disbursement date
generic.Exception handling path: Insufficient balance or mismatch routes back to Payroll Specialist before release
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Funding released only after approval and bank confirmation are both recorded
generic.Evidence location: ADP Payroll funding transaction log for the pay run

steps.title: Confirm the committed run's net-pay total matches the funding request
sop: Pull the committed pay run's total net-pay amount from ADP Payroll.
Compare it to the funding request amount prepared for the bank.
Done when the two amounts match exactly.
verify: Recompute the difference between the two amounts.
Pass when the difference is zero.

steps.title: Verify the disbursing bank account has sufficient available balance
sop: Check the disbursing account balance in the ERP/General ledger banking module.
Confirm the available balance covers the funding request amount.
Done when sufficient balance is confirmed before release.
verify: Compare the available balance to the funding request amount.
Pass when the balance exceeds the requested amount.

steps.title: Obtain funding release approval from the designated payroll approver
sop: Route the funding request to the designated payroll approver for sign-off.
Confirm the approver reviews the amount and account before approving.
Done when the approval is recorded against the funding request.
verify: Check the funding request for the approver's recorded sign-off.
Pass when a named approver's sign-off is present.

steps.title: Confirm the funding transaction reference is recorded against the pay run
sop: Submit the funding transaction to the bank and capture the reference number.
Attach the reference number to the pay run record.
Done when the reference number is recorded against the correct pay run.
verify: Open the pay run record and locate the funding reference number.
Pass when the reference number is present and correctly attached.

steps.title: Confirm bank funding confirmation is received before the disbursement date
sop: Monitor for the bank's funding confirmation after transaction submission.
Confirm the confirmation arrives before the scheduled disbursement date.
Done when the confirmation is received on time.
verify: Check the confirmation timestamp against the disbursement date.
Pass when confirmation precedes the disbursement date.

steps.title: File the funding confirmation with the pay-run evidence
sop: Save the bank funding confirmation to the pay-run evidence folder.
Label it with the pay-run date and funding reference number.
Done when the confirmation is retrievable with the pay run.
verify: Open the evidence folder and locate the confirmation file.
Pass when the confirmation with reference number is retrievable.

generic.Defined scope/population: The reconciled pay register awaiting HR Business Partner and Chief HR Officer sign-off
generic.In-scope period: The current pay period's register before release to disbursement
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Approver names and approval timestamps populated on the pay-run approval log
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Approved register total matches the reconciled register submitted for review
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Both approvals recorded with names and timestamps on the approval log
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any approver rejection or requested correction logged with resolution
generic.Test population: The full pay-run approval log for the current cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: HR Business Partner and Chief HR Officer approvals both recorded before release
generic.Exception handling path: Missing or rejected approvals block the status change to Released
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No status change to Released occurs until both approvals are recorded
generic.Evidence location: ADP Payroll pay-run approval log for the cycle

steps.title: Route the reconciled pay register to the HR Business Partner
sop: Attach the reconciled gross-to-net register to the approval workflow in ADP Payroll.
Send the routing notification to the HR Business Partner.
Done when the register is routed and pending HRBP review.
verify: Check the approval workflow status for the routed step.
Pass when the register shows pending HRBP review.

steps.title: Obtain HR Business Partner sign-off on the pay run
sop: Review the reconciled register for reasonableness against prior period and budget.
Record sign-off in ADP Payroll against the pay run.
Done when the HRBP sign-off is recorded on the pay run.
verify: Open the pay run approval log and check for the HRBP entry.
Pass when the HRBP sign-off appears with name and timestamp.

steps.title: Route the pay run for Chief HR Officer final approval
sop: Forward the HRBP-approved register to the Chief HR Officer for final review.
Confirm the CHRO reviews total payroll cost against budget expectations.
Done when the pay run is routed and pending CHRO approval.
verify: Check the approval workflow for the CHRO pending step.
Pass when the pay run shows pending CHRO review.

steps.title: Obtain Chief HR Officer approval before release
sop: Review the reconciled and HRBP-approved register for final sign-off.
Record the approval in ADP Payroll against the pay run.
Done when the CHRO approval is recorded with name and timestamp.
verify: Open the approval log and check for the CHRO entry.
Pass when the CHRO sign-off appears with name and timestamp.

steps.title: Confirm both approver names and timestamps are captured
sop: Open the pay-run approval log after both sign-offs are recorded.
Verify both HRBP and CHRO entries show name and timestamp.
Done when both entries are complete on the log.
verify: Review the approval log for both required entries.
Pass when both approver name/timestamp pairs are present.

steps.title: Confirm no status change to Released occurs before both approvals
sop: Check the pay run status field before both sign-offs are recorded.
Confirm the status cannot change to Released while either approval is missing.
Done when the system blocks Released status absent both approvals.
verify: Attempt to view the release step before both approvals post.
Pass when release remains blocked until both are recorded.

generic.Defined scope/population: The payroll journal entry file generated from the committed pay run
generic.In-scope period: The pay period whose journal is posted before the GL close cutoff
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every journal line mapped to a valid GL cost-center and account code
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Total debits equal total credits on the posted payroll journal batch
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: GL posting confirmation number recorded against the pay run
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any unmapped or out-of-balance journal line logged and corrected before posting
generic.Test population: The full payroll journal batch for the committed pay run
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Payroll journal batch posted with debits equal to credits and confirmation recorded
generic.Exception handling path: Out-of-balance or unmapped lines route back to Payroll Specialist before posting
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Journal batch posts before the close cutoff with a recorded GL confirmation number
generic.Evidence location: ERP/General ledger posting confirmation log for the pay period

steps.title: Generate the payroll journal entry file from ADP Payroll
sop: Open the committed pay run and select the journal entry export function.
Generate the file covering all earnings, deductions, and tax lines.
Done when the journal entry file is generated for the committed run.
verify: Open the generated file and confirm it covers the full committed run.
Pass when all earnings, deduction, and tax lines are present.

steps.title: Map each payroll journal line to the correct GL account
sop: Match each journal line's cost center and earnings code to its GL account mapping.
Correct any line missing or showing an invalid mapping.
Done when every line carries a valid GL cost-center and account code.
verify: Filter the journal file for unmapped or invalid account lines.
Pass when the filter returns zero unmapped lines.

steps.title: Post the payroll journal batch before the close cutoff
sop: Submit the mapped journal batch to the general ledger for posting.
Confirm the posting completes before the period close cutoff time.
Done when the batch posts successfully before cutoff.
verify: Check the GL posting timestamp against the close cutoff.
Pass when the batch posted before the cutoff time.

steps.title: Confirm the GL posting confirmation number is recorded
sop: Capture the GL posting confirmation number after the batch posts.
Attach the confirmation number to the pay run record.
Done when the confirmation number is recorded against the pay run.
verify: Open the pay run record and locate the GL confirmation number.
Pass when the confirmation number is present and correctly attached.

steps.title: Verify total debits equal total credits on the posted batch
sop: Pull the posted batch's total debit and credit amounts from the GL.
Compare the two totals for an exact balance.
Done when total debits equal total credits.
verify: Recompute the debit-credit difference on the posted batch.
Pass when the difference equals zero.

steps.title: File the posted journal and confirmation with close-package evidence
sop: Export the posted journal batch and confirmation number together.
Save the file to the period close-package evidence folder.
Done when the posted journal and confirmation are retrievable.
verify: Open the close-package folder and locate the saved file.
Pass when the journal and confirmation are both present.

generic.Defined scope/population: Off-cycle pay events: termination final pay, corrections, and court-ordered payments
generic.In-scope period: The off-cycle run date separate from the standard cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Off-cycle authorization, state final-pay rules, and payment election populated before release
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Off-cycle disbursement amount matches the calculated final-pay or correction amount
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Off-cycle authorization and approval retained with the run record
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any state-timing miss or unauthorized request logged with resolution
generic.Test population: All off-cycle runs processed in the current review period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Off-cycle run processed, approved, and disbursed within the state's required timeframe
generic.Exception handling path: Missing authorization or timing risk routes back to Payroll Specialist before the run builds
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Off-cycle disbursement matches the employee's on-file election or state-required method
generic.Evidence location: ADP Payroll off-cycle run record and authorization file

steps.title: Confirm the off-cycle request is documented with supporting authorization
sop: Pull the termination notice, correction request, or court order for the off-cycle event.
Confirm the document is signed or authorized by the appropriate party.
Done when supporting authorization is attached to the off-cycle request.
verify: Open the request file and confirm the authorization document is attached.
Pass when a valid, signed authorization is present.

steps.title: Calculate final pay per state final-pay-timing rules
sop: Look up the applicable state's final-pay timing and calculation rules for the termination type.
Calculate the final pay amount including accrued and unused balances per state rules.
Done when the calculated amount follows the applicable state rule.
verify: Recompute the final pay figure against the state rule manually.
Pass when the recomputed figure matches the calculated amount.

steps.title: Build the off-cycle run separate from the standard cycle
sop: Create a new off-cycle run in ADP Payroll distinct from the standard pay cycle.
Enter the calculated final-pay, correction, or court-order amount into the run.
Done when the off-cycle run is built and ready for approval.
verify: Open the off-cycle run and confirm it is separate from the standard cycle.
Pass when the run is correctly flagged as off-cycle.

steps.title: Obtain payroll approval on the off-cycle run
sop: Route the built off-cycle run to the payroll approver for review.
Confirm the approver reviews the amount and authorization before signing off.
Done when approval is recorded against the off-cycle run.
verify: Check the off-cycle run for the recorded approval entry.
Pass when a named approver's sign-off is present.

steps.title: Confirm the disbursement method matches the employee's election
sop: Check the employee's on-file payment election or the state-required method for the event type.
Set the off-cycle disbursement to match that election or requirement.
Done when the disbursement method is correctly set.
verify: Compare the disbursement method used to the on-file election or state rule.
Pass when the two match exactly.

steps.title: Confirm disbursement occurs within the state's required timeframe
sop: Check the disbursement date against the state's required final-pay deadline.
Escalate immediately if the deadline is at risk of being missed.
Done when the disbursement completes within the required timeframe.
verify: Compare the disbursement date to the state deadline.
Pass when disbursement occurs on or before the required deadline.

generic.Defined scope/population: All employees in the committed pay run receiving direct deposit or a physical check
generic.In-scope period: The current committed pay run's disbursement window
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Direct-deposit file and check register populated with correct amounts before transmission
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Disbursed direct-deposit and check totals reconcile to the committed pay register
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Check numbers and NACHA transmission log retained with the pay period
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any disbursement discrepancy logged with root cause and correction
generic.Test population: The full direct-deposit file and physical check run for the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero discrepancies between disbursed amounts and the committed pay register
generic.Exception handling path: Discrepancies route back to Payroll Specialist before disbursement is finalized
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Direct deposit transmitted and checks issued matching the committed register exactly
generic.Evidence location: ADP Payroll disbursement log and check register for the pay period

steps.title: Confirm the direct-deposit file matches the committed pay run total
sop: Generate the direct-deposit file from the committed pay run.
Compare the file's total dollar amount to the committed register total.
Done when the two totals match exactly.
verify: Recompute the difference between file total and register total.
Pass when the difference is zero.

steps.title: Transmit the direct-deposit NACHA file within the required lead time
sop: Encrypt and submit the NACHA file to the disbursing bank.
Confirm transmission occurs within the bank's required lead time before pay date.
Done when the bank confirms receipt within the lead-time window.
verify: Check the bank's receipt confirmation timestamp against the lead-time requirement.
Pass when receipt is confirmed within the required window.

steps.title: Print and reconcile physical checks for non-direct-deposit employees
sop: Print checks for employees without direct deposit on file.
Reconcile the printed check total to the corresponding register amounts.
Done when all non-direct-deposit employees have a matching check.
verify: Compare printed check total to the register total for check recipients.
Pass when the two totals match exactly.

steps.title: Log the issued check numbers against the pay register
sop: Record each issued check number next to the corresponding employee on the register.
Confirm no check number is duplicated or skipped without explanation.
Done when every issued check number is logged against its register line.
verify: Scan the check-number log for duplicates or gaps.
Pass when no unexplained duplicate or gap exists.

steps.title: Confirm zero discrepancies between disbursed amounts and the register
sop: Compare total disbursed direct-deposit and check amounts to the committed register.
Investigate and resolve any variance found.
Done when disbursed totals match the committed register exactly.
verify: Recompute the variance between disbursed and committed totals.
Pass when the variance equals zero.

steps.title: Retain the disbursement log and check register as evidence

steps.title: Confirm each entry states definition, source, and calculation logic

steps.title: Publish the updated data dictionary to the SharePoint site
sop: Upload the finalized data dictionary to the HR systems SharePoint site.

steps.title: Confirm the version and last-reviewed date are current

steps.title: Retain the prior version as historical evidence

Save the archived version with its retirement date.
Done when the prior version is retrievable as historical record.
verify: Open the archive folder and locate the prior version.
Pass when the prior version with retirement date is present.

steps.title: Update job data changes with the correct effective date

steps.title: Confirm compensation changes tie to the approved compensation action

steps.title: Verify employment history entries are complete and consistent

Correct any gap or overlapping entry found.

steps.title: Run the worker data completeness report

steps.title: Confirm testing evidence is attached before production migration

Attach the test results and evidence to the change ticket.

Confirm the production build matches the tested non-production build.

verify: Compare the production configuration to the tested non-production build.

steps.title: Review the transaction audit trail for preparer and approval
sop: Open the audit trail for each processed transaction.

Pass when zero records fail validation.
